title: parametric functions
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate parametric surfaces: torus, Klein, Mobius, super toroid, ellipsoid, splines, and more.

**dataset → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkActor2D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor2D.html) — actor2d.
- [vtkParametricBoy](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricBoy.html) — parametric boy.
- [vtkParametricConicSpiral](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricConicSpiral.html) — parametric conic spiral.
- [vtkParametricCrossCap](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricCrossCap.html) — parametric cross cap.
- [vtkParametricDini](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricDini.html) — parametric dini.
- [vtkParametricEllipsoid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricEllipsoid.html) — parametric ellipsoid.
- [vtkParametricEnneper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricEnneper.html) — parametric enneper.
- [vtkParametricFigure8Klein](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricFigure8Klein.html) — parametric figure8klein.
- [vtkParametricFunctionSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricFunctionSource.html) — parametric function source.
- [vtkParametricKlein](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricKlein.html) — parametric klein.
- [vtkParametricMobius](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricMobius.html) — parametric mobius.
- [vtkParametricRandomHills](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricRandomHills.html) — parametric random hills.
- [vtkParametricRoman](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricRoman.html) — parametric roman.
- [vtkParametricSpline](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricSpline.html) — parametric spline.
- [vtkParametricSuperEllipsoid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricSuperEllipsoid.html) — parametric super ellipsoid.
- [vtkParametricSuperToroid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricSuperToroid.html) — parametric super toroid.
- [vtkParametricTorus](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricTorus.html) — parametric torus.
- [vtkPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPoints.html) — stores 3D point coordinates.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkTextMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTextMapper.html) — text mapper.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
